title: Still very limited
body:
After several updates, this app still in it's very design, lack of functionality and very limited integration. 

You should rethink about the integration to several other important and popular health apps out there instead of forcing your customers to only use your very own poor app. 

Being iOS users we can't even sync our health data to Apple Health which is absolutely useless since your app doesn't do much for us instead of keep track of our activities while at the same time a lot of other apps offer free additional analyst using our health data (which you don't share) to let know more comprehensive about our health.

I highly look forward to the big upgrade soon.
author: Jeff de man
